verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI file-storage product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows on-request agent tasks ("automate tasks like organizing a folder"), a scriptable CLI, and built-in background indexing and sync. None of these is a documented way for users to define rules that fire actions automatically on events. The CLI is a developer building block and the background processing is fixed behaviour, so neither earns credit.
